name: Band external rotation
description: Keep your elbow at your side and rotate the band outward slowly.

name: Wall slide
description: Slide your arms up a wall in a V shape, keeping your wrists and elbows in contact.

name: Prone Y raise
description: Lie face down and raise your arms in a Y shape, squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to shoulder height with a slight bend in your elbows.

name: Cable lateral raise
description: Raise the cable handle out to the side at shoulder height with steady tension.

name: Rear delt fly
description: Bend forward and raise dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing the back of your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
description: Press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height, then lower them under control.

name: Pike push-up
description: With your hips high, lower your head toward the floor and press back up.

name: Arnold press
description: Start with palms facing you, then rotate as you press overhead.
caution: Shoulder impingement risk. Stop if you feel pinching or pain at the top.

name: Barbell overhead press
description: Press the bar from the front of your shoulders to overhead with a braced core.
caution: Brace the core and use a rack and spotter for heavy sets.

name: Shoulder roll
description: Lift your shoulders toward your ears, then roll them slowly back and down.

name: Overhead reach
description: Raise both arms slowly overhead, reach tall, then lower them with control.
